name: io.github.swaphunt/swaphunt-mcp
title: SwapHunt crypto market context
description: Hyperliquid prices, regime, vol, funding, FOMO checks (x402, USDC); free Kalshi/Polymarket fees

environmentVariables.name: X402_PAY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to pay for calls. Without it every tool is a dry run that only reports the price.

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file with the private key of a dedicated wallet holding a few dollars of USDC on Base

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet (alternative to PRIVATE_KEY_FILE)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spending cap per session in USD

environmentVariables.name: PAYTO_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated addresses the server may pay; any other payTo is refused before signing
